'''''Gaillardia amblyodon''''', the '''lanceleaf blanketflower''' or '''maroon blanketflower''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=GAAM|taxon=Gaillardia amblyodon|accessdate=16 July 2015}}</ref> is a species of flowering plant in the [[Asteraceae|aster family]].<ref>[http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/record/gcc-116470 The Plant List, ''Gaillardia amblyodon'' J.Gay ]</ref> It has been found only in the state of [[Texas]] in the south-central United States.<ref>[https://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Gaillardia%20amblyodon.png Biota of North America Program 2014 county distribution map]</ref>

''Gaillardia amblyodon '' grows in open, sunlit locations on sandy soils. It is an annual herb up to {{convert|45|cm|in|abbr=on}} tall with leafy stems. Each flower head is on its own flower stalk up to {{convert|15|cm|in|abbr=on}} long. Each head has 8-12 red or purple (rarely yellow) ray flowers surrounding 30-60 disc flowers (yellow with purple tips). The species appears to be closely related to the more widespread ''[[Gaillardia pulchella|G. pulchella]].''<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=250066783 Flora of North America, ''Gaillardia amblyodon'' Gay, 1839. ]</ref>
